channel.title: Morning Brief · Salud y seguridad de la familia
channel.description: Retiros de productos, alertas de salud, seguridad alimentaria y desastres

item.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in Abuja as woman who arrived from Uganda tests positive
item.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) is assisting Nigeria following confirmation of the first case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease in the country. [Confirmado] Fuentes: UN News, Associated Press, Reuters

item.title: Russia frees American Stephen Hubbard after over 4 years in prison, during a visit by US envoy
item.description: The 74-year-old former teacher has been released without any "swap" required, Trump says. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, BBC News

item.title: Las gafas tradicionales de EssilorLuxottica compensan la desaceleración de las gafas inteligentes
item.description: La patilla izquierda de las gafas inteligentes retiradas del mercado puede sobrecalentarse durante un uso prolongado, lo que supone un riesgo de lesiones graves o muerte debido al peligro de quemaduras. [Confirmado] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, Financial Times

item.title: Agrish Reannounces and Expands Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Additional Units Added
item.description: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because when the bed rails are attached to a bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress,… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: Evacuations and shelter-in-place orders issued in Toledo, Ohio, after chemical release
item.description: A hazardous chemical leak in Toledo, Ohio, has prompted the evacuation of homes and businesses within a one-mile radius of a pipe factory. Anyone living within three miles of the plant is being asked to shelter in place. There are no… [Probable] Fuentes: Associated Press, NBC News, CBS News

item.title: Giant Bicycle retira del mercado las llaves con luz LED incluidas en los juegos de candados para bicicleta SureLock debido al riesgo de lesiones graves o muerte por ingestión de baterías; viola la norma obligatoria para productos de consumo con baterías de botón
